描述_EN: the height of cong varies drastically, ranging from 49 cm to a mere 3 cm. but long before writing was invented in china jade cong were used in a ritual context. tall cong are definitely more difficult to make than short ones. the outside walls are usually divided into sections by horizontal cuts in the four corners. a ‘cong’ is a jade cylinder that is square on the outside with a round perforation in the middle. an ancient chinese text called 'the rites of zhou' states that the cong was used to sacrifice to earth. recent archaeology in china has unearthed considerable quantity of cong from neolithic burial sites.
描述_ZN: 琮的高度差异很大，从49厘米到仅有3厘米不等。 但早在中国发明文字之前，玉琮就被用于祭祀。 高的铜钱肯定比短的更难制作。 外墙通常由四角的横切面分成若干部分。 一个 "琮 "是一个玉筒，外面是方形，中间有一个圆形的孔。 中国古籍《周礼》中说，琮是用来祭祀大地的。 最近在中国的考古工作中，从新石器时代的墓葬中发掘出了大量的玉琮。
